# Logrith

> Logrith is a free, browser-based online tools platform offering 100+ utilities across image/PDF editing, calculators and converters, text and generators, developer tools, and general utilities. All tools run directly in the browser where technically possible — no signup, no file uploads to third-party servers for most tools, no unnecessary data collection, and no paywall.

Logrith's positioning: a simple, fast, privacy-respecting place to get a small digital task done — compress, convert, calculate, generate, clean, format, transform, check, compare, create.

## Founder

Logrith is built and run by a solo founder, Ankush Maurya (online identity: Plert Ankush, same handle "plertankush" across platforms). The platform's tools, content, and SEO are developed using AI-assisted development ("vibecoding") directed and reviewed by the founder, who acts as strategist and editor while AI tooling does the hands-on building. Full founder profile: https://logrith.in/pages/founder

## Notable Tools (high traffic / high utility)

- Age Calculator: https://logrith.in/tools/age-calculator — exact age by date of birth, in years/months/days/hours/minutes
- World Clock: https://logrith.in/tools/world-clock — live time across multiple cities and timezones

- Text Reverser: https://logrith.in/tools/text-reverser — reverse text by character or word order

## Content & Blog

Logrith publishes explainer blog posts for its highest-traffic tools at https://logrith.in/blog/ — these cover how each tool works, common misconceptions, and practical usage guidance rather than generic SEO filler.

## Technical Notes for Crawlers/Agents

- Site is static HTML, mobile-responsive.
- Most tools process data entirely client-side (in-browser); server upload is used only where technically required (noted per tool).
- No login or account system; no paywalled tools.
- Monetization is via non-intrusive display ads (Google AdSense) only — no sponsored tool rankings, no affiliate manipulation of results.
- Sitemaps: https://logrith.in/sitemap.xml (index), https://logrith.in/sitemap-tools.xml, https://logrith.in/sitemap-blog.xml, https://logrith.in/sitemap-pages.xml
